title: Stabilize eval orchestrator and modernize load scratchpad
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Scope: Reduce flakiness and maintenance overhead in the evaluation / benchmarking orchestration layer and replace legacy load scratchpad scripts with a small, testable runner. Goals: 1) Remove brittle shell-based wiring between eval jobs and CI; 2) Replace ad-hoc Python scripts under perf/tools/scratchpad with a reusable runner that supports scenario wiring, stable KV-cache mocking, and deterministic seeds; 3) Upgrade pytest/locust/requests-related dependencies to supported LTS versions and validate against runtime docker images; 4) Add a minimal perf-regression smoke job that runs in CI and gates releases for obvious regressions. Non‑goals: Full rewrite of the load generator, replacing the production serving runtime, or adding long-running multi-hour scale tests in this ticket. Rationale: Over the last two quarters we've observed intermittent CI failures (25% of perf jobs), test logic duplicated across teams, and slow iteration cycle for small perf fixes. This work reduces developer friction and lowers the cost of maintaining perf suites.
comments: 2025-02-14: Initial write-up and scope agreed in sync with PM and Reliability (notes linked).

2025-02-18: Spike completed — prototype runner (perf-runner-v0) can drive 1k short sequences using the model-stub harness. Benchmark parity test created comparing old scratchpad vs prototype (results/graphs linked).
2025-02-21: Dependency audit: identified vulnerable transitive dep in locust-plugins and outdated pytest plugin causing flaky xdist behavior. Posted upgrade plan and risk matrix in doc.

2025-02-24: Design review with infra: decided to keep existing loadbench adapter for heavy lift; new runner will live under perf/runner and emit JUnit + JSON traces for CI dashboards. Diego assigned as owner.
2025-02-27: PR #4123 opened (perf-runner: add scenario wiring + deterministic seeding). CI flaky on testimage: pinned base image digest in PR; follow-up to coordinate with infra image-repo.
2025-03-02: Codeowners feedback received — add feature flag to opt-in for new runner in release branches. Added acceptance criteria item for metrics parity and observed stability improvement.
acceptance_criteria: New perf-runner can execute the existing 6 smoke scenarios with identical token distributions within ±5% of baseline cost
CI smoke job runs and reports JUnit/JSON artifacts without flakiness >95% pass over 3 runs
All obsolete scratchpad scripts removed or moved under perf/legacy with README and deprecation note
Dependencies upgraded: pytest >=7.2.x, locust pinned to supported patch, and no high or critical CVEs from the audit
Image digests pinned for perf CI to avoid transient base-image breakage and documented in perf/infra/README
